evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch 110-176) runs on pull_request with `permissions: contents: read` and runs scripts that exist in site/package.json: `npm ci`, `npm test` (pretest → prepare-data), `npm run build` (svelte-check + vite build), `npm run sample-bullets`, then a clean-tree check. The generated files are ignored by site/.gitignore, so that check works. pages.yml (177-256) triggers on push to main and workflow_dispatch. Its top-level permission is contents: read, and only the deploy job gets pages: write and id-token: write. It sets PAGES_BASE, which site/vite.config.ts:11 really reads. release.yml has contents: write for one job and uses only github.token. There is no pull_request_target and no other secret. pr-title.yml passes the title through env, not inline interpolation. Main defect: no action is pinned to a commit SHA. `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` and `actions/deploy-pages@v4` all use mutable tags (step1.patch 144, 146, 239, 256, 328, 352). Minor: pages.yml's workflow_dispatch has no `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` guard, so a deploy from another branch is stopped only by the environment rule that RELEASING.md asks admins to set. Nothing was run or published.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 517-655) covers requirements (Node 22 via .node-version), install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), other scripts (prepare-data, sample-bullets, preview), test (`npm test`), build (`npm run build`, plus `PAGES_BASE=… npm run build`), CI/CD, data contribution (issue forms, steps for editing JSON, generated sample bullets, pinned catalogue sizes), commit convention, versioning and license (MIT, matching LICENSE). Every command shown exists in site/package.json, and `.github/scripts/changelog-section.sh` exists.
evidence.s1_release: One consistent strategy. The version lives in site/package.json (0.1.0, `npm version --no-git-tag-version`). Releases come from a tag-triggered release.yml that checks the tag against package.json and against main, and extracts notes with changelog-section.sh. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 plus SemVer and the heading format. RELEASING.md gives the bump rules and procedure. Dependabot covers npm with groups and GitHub Actions, using commit prefixes chore/ci that match the convention. CONTRIBUTING.md states Conventional Commits with a type table, and pr-title.yml enforces it. All 7 commits in commits.txt follow the convention (ci:, ci(deps):, ci(release):, docs:, feat(site):, fix(site):). Tiny inconsistency: CONTRIBUTING says CI changes need no changelog line, but the step 1 Unreleased section lists them.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed in router.ts (step2.patch 598-609) and loads both records itself, so it survives a reload. The SVG has role=img, aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, and one `<path>` per outline from caseOuterProfile via viewportFor/fullSectionPath, at one scale with zMin aligned. Shot cartridges return null. The table has caption `Dimensions ({unit})`, headers Symbol/name A/name B/Difference, and symbols from FIELD_LABELS. Rows are only from the cartridge part, excluding *Tol and FIELD_UNITS fields, with Difference = b − a. Units follow unitSystem(): imperial uses displayNumber(…,'in'), and metric values use formatValue. CompareWith.svelte gives a `Compare with` label and select listing the other cartridges by name, plus a `Compare` button that sets href.compare(key, chosen). German strings are added. Partial: metric differences use displayNumber(diff,'mm') (toPrecision(12)) rather than formatValue as the step's 'written the same way' says, a deliberate choice to strip float noise (compare.ts formatDifference).
evidence.s2_correctness: Checked against data: 308 Win. eMin 1.4 vs 300 WM 0.94 → −0.46; L3 51.18/66.55. beta/delta/alpha and the pressures are correctly excluded via FIELD_UNITS, and S, f and L3PlusG are included. A symbol in two groups (alpha in junctionCone and dimensions) is counted once. Repeating groups and the chamber are skipped. viewportFor over both profiles gives one scale, with the head face (zMin) at the same x and the axis on one line. Undrawable records fall back to a note. Malformed routes fall back to the list. Imperial conversion is exactly displayNumber.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses @lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, toleranceFor, formatValue), @lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), @lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), the site's units.ts/units.svelte.ts, data.load/entries, PageHeader, and the shadcn Button/Label/NativeSelect. The route is added in the existing lazy-chunk map in App.svelte, the Route union, href, metadata.ts and SiteNavigation. Styles follow the `@layer legacy { :global([data-ui=…]) }` pattern of Cartridge.svelte. The logic sits framework-free in site/src/lib/compare.ts, beside router.ts/units.ts. The change is limited to what the feature needs.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests dimension selection against real records (tolerances, units, chamber, repeating groups, duplicate symbols, all records), rows and B−A, metric/imperial formatting via formatValue/displayNumber, and the overlay geometry (one path each, equal scale, aligned head faces, shared axis, in-box). It also tests drawable records and shot exclusion. router.test.ts adds round-trip, reload and malformed-hash cases. Both use the repo's vitest setup and lib/testing/fixtures. Not covered: no test checks the accessible name of the SVG, the table caption and headers, or the Compare with select and button. The repo has no component-test tooling, so these were left untested.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows now builds the union of fields, with a: number|null, b: number|null, and difference null unless both publish it (step3.patch 128-167). A field only B publishes is placed after its predecessor in B's order. Compare.svelte renders '' for null cells. Tests cover delta L (308 only) and R3 (300 WM only) with empty cells, and the union ordering. Style: the three numeric th and td get class `n` with `text-align: right`, matching GroupTable's right-aligned th/td. The step 2 CSS already had `th, td { text-align: right }` with first-child left, so the rule is redundant but harmless. The text changes (lede, differenceNote, noRows in EN and DE) follow from the fix. No unrelated changes.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added an `### Added` line under `## [Unreleased]`, and step 3 amended it, which suits a still-unreleased feature. The strategy bumps the version only at release, so leaving 0.1.0 is correct. Commits `feat(site): …` and `fix(site): …` follow Conventional Commits and fit the 100-character PR title check. The code is type-annotated for the svelte-check step in `npm run build` (null narrowing in the template, `!` in tests), and the tests use the repo's vitest setup. Nothing visible would break CI.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / review criterion: the workflows' actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3, actions/deploy-pages@v4) are not pinned to full commit SHAs
Step 1: pages.yml workflow_dispatch can run from any branch; the only thing stopping a non-main deploy is the github-pages environment rule, which has to be configured
Step 2 (partly met): metric differences are written with displayNumber (toPrecision(12)) rather than formatValue as the step specifies
strengths: The compare view reuses lib/core, lib/geom and lib/shapes2d directly and keeps its rules in a framework-free, well-tested site/src/lib/compare.ts, so all requirements are met with little new code

A coherent, enforced release setup: version in site/package.json, a tag release that checks the tag against package.json and main, Keep a Changelog notes extraction, Dependabot, and a Conventional Commits PR-title check, all documented in README/CONTRIBUTING/RELEASING
The step 3 bug fix lists the union of dimensions with null cells, keeps a sensible order, and updates tests, translations and the changelog consistently
issues: None of the GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (checkout, setup-node, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages use @vN tags), a supply-chain risk for a repo that accepts outside PRs
pages.yml allows workflow_dispatch without a main-branch guard, so restricting deploys to main relies on an environment setting

Metric differences use displayNumber instead of formatValue as specified, and the step 3 alignment rule repeats CSS that already right-aligned those cells; neither the SVG's accessible name nor the table headers are covered by a test
review.verdict: The work is solid: the compare feature is correct, fits the codebase's modules and style, is well tested at the logic level, and both review points were fixed cleanly within a consistent, documented release and commit strategy. The main thing blocking a clean merge is that the CI, Pages and release workflows reference actions by mutable tags rather than commit SHAs, plus a minor Pages dispatch guard and a small spec deviation in how metric differences are formatted.
